key_reasoning.reason: Reuses the existing budgetNumber parse/validation helpers and BudgetOverrideCategoryCard, but adds new focus/blur state for Mixed fields (clear on focus, restore on blur, revert when emptied, survive a budgets refresh). The acceptance criteria list specific edge cases (empty, lone dot, unparseable, retyped original value, mixed-field emptying), and these are covered by new parameterized edge-case and error-path tests, so this bumps from S to M. The work is client-side only and has no security or performance sensitivity.

Changes are limited to one UI component, BulkBudgetOverrideModal, and its unit tests, with no layer boundary crossed. The 11-point total matches the bundled S example epmcdme-10102-add-validation-to-form-field (also 11). It is above the XS example because it adds non-trivial state and validation logic rather than one isolated line change.
